schema: CREATE TABLE events (created_at TIMESTAMP);
expected_spark: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', created_at) AS month, COUNT(*) AS event_count FROM events GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', created_at)

schema: CREATE TABLE seed (id INT);

postgres: SELECT payload #>> '{profile,city}' AS city FROM events

postgres: SELECT DISTINCT ON (customer_id) customer_id, created_at FROM orders ORDER BY customer_id, created_at DESC
schema: CREATE TABLE orders (customer_id INT, created_at TIMESTAMP);

postgres: SELECT order_id, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY created_at) AS rn FROM orders
schema: CREATE TABLE orders (order_id BIGINT, customer_id INT, created_at TIMESTAMP);
expected_spark: SELECT order_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY created_at NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM orders

postgres: SELECT customer_id, lag(amount, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY created_at) AS prior_amount FROM payments
schema: CREATE TABLE payments (customer_id INT, amount DECIMAL(12,2), created_at TIMESTAMP);
expected_spark: SELECT customer_id, LAG(amount, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY created_at NULLS LAST) AS prior_amount FROM payments

postgres: SELECT account_id, sum(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY posted_at) AS running_total FROM ledger
schema: CREATE TABLE ledger (account_id BIGINT, amount DECIMAL(12,2), posted_at TIMESTAMP);
expected_spark: SELECT account_id, SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY posted_at NULLS LAST) AS running_total FROM ledger
